name: Cannibal Tales
source:
In the first Cannibal Tales episode, "The Interview", you play the role of a young and ambitious journalist determined to make a career.
Your goal is to get a scoop that will allow you to become a partner in the newspaper you work for.

You focus on the mystery surrounding a young survivor of a metropolitan cannibal, determined to obtain an interview to unravel the connection between them and understand the reason behind his life being spared, unaware of the dangerous consequences that this choice will entail.
During the interview, your morality will be put to the test as the line between good and evil grows increasingly blurred.
Will you let yourself be consumed by selfishness and the pursuit of personal success, or will you do what is right?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431840/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在食人族故事的第一集“采访”中，你扮演一位年轻而雄心勃勃的记者，决心开创自己的职业生涯。
你的目标是获得独家新闻，让你成为你所在报纸的合伙人。

你聚焦于一名都市食人者的年轻幸存者的谜团，决心接受采访以揭开他们之间的联系，并了解他幸免于难的原因，却没有意识到这一选择将带来的危险后果。
在面试过程中，随着善恶之间的界限变得越来越模糊，你的道德将受到考验。
你会让自己被自私和追求个人成功所吞噬，还是会做正确的事？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431840/]Steam[/url]]
